playbook:
PLAYBOOK -- design X-demo7 (carried under E-9001)
The declaration: prereg/X-demo7_playbook.json, sha256 a3ebab7bdccf7d97170dbe70777279bd45315ce60513156ca385bfbc3dbf4907 (pinned in E-9001).

HAND ENTRY ONLY. You enter every order yourself, by hand, on the firm's platform. Nothing in this playbook or its alerts places, sends or automates an order: no automated or API order entry, ever (it gets prop accounts banned).
NEVER HOLD OPPOSITE POSITIONS AT ONCE across your accounts or firms. While any position is open in any of your accounts, a new trade is taken only on that position's side; otherwise skip it.
One trade goes to one account. Never copy a trade to several accounts.
Never put size into major news: no entry and no working order inside a news window; a position open when a window starts is closed at its start.
No price is printed here: every order is stated against what you read on your platform when the alert reaches you.

FIRM AND PLAN
Firm: topstep; plan: 50K Trading Combine (as the firm's verified rules name it); instrument: MNQ.
Accounts, in the account order:
  - ts_a1: an evaluation account (the Trading Combine); at most 50 contracts of MNQ open at once (the firm's verified limit).
  - ts_b2: a funded account (the Express Funded Account; its scaling plan's entry tier, the lowest, bounds the size); at most 20 contracts of MNQ open at once (the firm's verified limit).
  - ts_c3: an evaluation account (the Trading Combine); at most 50 contracts of MNQ open at once (the firm's verified limit).

COMPONENTS (one session window each; times in CT, Chicago)
Component ldn_brk -- session london: orders go live from 03:00 CT to 04:00 CT.
  Trigger (p14): a breakout: the first one-minute close above the previous completed reference bar's high, or below its low (the reference bar's length in minutes is the parameter k), at most once per reference bar.
    entry: market
    first: 02:55 CT
    last: 03:55 CT
    latency: 5
  Entry: a market order when the order goes live. The alert reaches you 5 minutes before the order goes live.
  Side (the trigger's own, cleared by the no-harm floor under E-9002):
    with the breakout: BUY after a close above the reference bar's high, SELL after a close below its low.
  Size: 3 contracts of MNQ.
  Stop: 77 ticks from your fill. Target: 100 ticks (reward to risk 1.3). Both are placed with the entry as a bracket.
  The session's local open: 08:00 Europe/London.
    on 2021-03-16 that is 03:00 CT
    on 2021-04-06 that is 02:00 CT
Component am_rl3 -- session ny_am: orders go live from 09:00 CT to 09:55 CT.
  Trigger (rl3): pre-session tickets at the day's levels of one kind, fixed when the alert is sent, before the regular session's first fill; one ticket per level, the tickets of a kind one-cancels-other, unfilled tickets cancelled at the cutoff.
    cutoff: 10:00 CT
    kind: pd
  Entry: each level's ticket by its declared rule: a fade is a limit at the level, a break a stop one tick beyond it. The tickets are fixed at 08:30 CT, when the alert is sent, and go live at 09:00 CT.
  Side (the trigger's own, cleared by the no-harm floor under E-9002):
    at the previous day's regular-session high: fade: a limit at the level against the approach (SELL at a level above the price at the alert, BUY at one below it).
    at the previous day's regular-session low: break: a stop one tick beyond the level (BUY above a level above the price at the alert, SELL below one below it).
  Size: 2 contracts of MNQ.
  Stop: 100 ticks from your fill. Target: 150 ticks (reward to risk 1.5). Both are placed with the entry as a bracket.
  The session's local open: 09:30 America/New_York.
    on 2021-03-16 that is 08:30 CT
    on 2021-04-06 that is 08:30 CT
Component pm_brk -- session ny_pm: orders go live from 11:00 CT to 14:00 CT.
  Trigger (p14): a breakout: the first one-minute close above the previous completed reference bar's high, or below its low (the reference bar's length in minutes is the parameter k), at most once per reference bar.
    entry: limit
    first: 10:57 CT
    last: 13:57 CT
    latency: 3
  Entry: a limit order at the price at the alert (the close of the one-minute bar ending at the alert), working the limit window from when it goes live, cancelled if unfilled. The alert reaches you 3 minutes before the order goes live.
  Side (the trigger's own, cleared by the no-harm floor under E-9002):
    against the breakout: SELL after a close above the reference bar's high, BUY after a close below its low.
  Size: 1 contracts of MNQ.
  Stop: 60 ticks from your fill. Target: 135 ticks (reward to risk 2.25). Both are placed with the entry as a bracket.
  The session's local open: 09:30 America/New_York.
    on 2021-03-16 that is 08:30 CT
    on 2021-04-06 that is 08:30 CT
The no-harm floor's file: results/noharm_x.csv (commit abc1234def): the trigger's own side against the coin's on the real path, same fills, no redraw; every component above passed it.

EXECUTION RULES (every component)
- One position or working entry order at a time per firm; after a position closes, wait at least 5 minutes before the next entry.
- Limit orders work 30 minutes from going live, then are cancelled.
- Closed window: no entry and no fill from 08:30 CT to 08:59 CT, every day.
- On a jobs-report day: no entry at or before 07:35 CT.
- No new entry after 15:08 CT. Flatten every position by the bar ending 15:08 CT at the latest.
- A working order is cancelled when a news or closed window starts; an open position is closed at its start.
News windows (no entry and no fill inside them):
  - CPI (synthetic record key): released at 07:30 CT; the window runs from 2 minutes before to 7 minutes after; on 2021-03-16, 2021-04-07.
  - a synthetic afternoon release: released at 12:00 CT; the window runs from 3 minutes before to 6 minutes after; on 2021-03-17.
Void days (no trade from the components named):
  - an FOMC statement day: no trade at all that day.
  - an exchange holiday or a scheduled close before the walk's last bar: no trade that day.
  - an early end of the day's bars, or a data defect on the calendar: no trade that day.
  - an overnight session the calendar voids (its data-integrity void days, too many minutes missing, or no last bar before the regular open for a component that reads it): no trade from a component that reads the overnight bars.
  - the day after an abbreviated session, a closure, a void day or a contract roll: no trade from a component that reads the previous day's levels.
  - 2021-03-19: an early end of the day's bars, or a data defect on the calendar: no trade that day.

ACCOUNT ROTATION
Rule by_component: each component's trades go to its own pool of accounts below, the one waiting longest first (a component without a pool uses every account).
  component am_rl3: ts_a1, ts_c3
  component pm_brk: ts_b2
One trade goes to one account. Never copy a trade to several accounts.

THE BANKROLL STOP
Budget: $1700 (set under E-9003). When your total spending on this plan reaches it before a first payout, stop: buy no further evaluation and no reset, add no money, and keep trading only the accounts you already hold until each is passed or lost.

THE EXPECTED JOURNEY
From the result file results/journey_x.csv (commit abc1234def):
  - sessions to the first payout: 37.5 (search years: the years this design was chosen on, so likely better than what follows; median)
    its held-out reading is not named here: read it beside before trusting this figure.
  - chance of running out at the budget: 0.1234 (search years: the years this design was chosen on, so likely better than what follows; value)
    its held-out reading is not named here: read it beside before trusting this figure.
  - bankroll needed, unlucky tenth: 1543.25 (search years: the years this design was chosen on, so likely better than what follows; p90)
  - bankroll needed, unlucky tenth: 1611.5 (held-out years, reported beside, never judged; p90)
These figures were measured with every trade's direction replaced by a fair coin (zero edge), over many start days: they are what the account policy gives without any skill in direction. Your own journey will differ.
